o.text: From Proto-Turkic *köč- (“to move”) Cognate with Turkmen and Turkish göçmek, Crimean Tatar köçmek, Chuvash куҫ (kuś).
From Arabic جِهَاز (jihāz). Doublet of cehiz.
From Proto-Common Turkic *čērig, from Proto-Turkic, compare Chuvash ҫар (śar).

From Proto-Turkic *sak- (“aware; to be aware”).
Compare Turkish sakınmak (“to beware”), Khorezmian Turkic ساقینماق (“to think”).
From bir + hədd + -li. Calque of Russian одночле́н (odnočlén).
